allowed_pair_policy: Adjacent rigid groups; mounted base/shoulder against stand; TacCap coupled finger roots (source meshes contact at default opening); same-arm pairs within 2 revolute joints whose source meshes are proven >= 5 mm apart over the full joint range by branch-and-bound. No sample-based disabling.

finger_fit.method: clipped-triangle support polytopes, intersected with legacy padded-box envelope
